descriptions.g4b_bind_lua_callbacks_8019fa44: Binds the external host and retains this binding, releases the prior host binding, obtains the Lua state through host slot36, creates two referenced tables and registers index/newindex closures with distinct write callbacks plus XomCreateInstance in the globals table. Stores registry references at24 and28, restores stack levels, returns zero. Partial external receiver views are never locally constructed; all keys, callbacks and registration lists remain external.
